data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for BLE peripheral/GATT server on Android, iOS, macOS, and Windows
data.what_it_does: Provides APIs to create BLE peripherals, add services and characteristics, advertise, and handle read/write/subscribe callbacks. It supports dynamic service management and client tracking. The plugin is a maintained fork of ble_peripheral with added Android bonding and subscription utilities.
use_when: You need to expose BLE services from a Flutter app
You require dynamic service addition/removal at runtime
You need to track subscribed clients and update characteristics per client
avoid_when: You only need BLE central functionality
You want a lightweight library without platform permissions
strengths: Maintained fork with bug fixes and newer Flutter compatibility
Adds getSubscribedClients() and Android requireBonding support
Keeps original API for easy migration
weaknesses: Requires platform‑specific permissions and Info.plist entries
Setup involves multiple native permission steps
data.setup_notes: Android: add BLUETOOTH, BLUETOOTH_ADMIN, BLUETOOTH_CONNECT, BLUETOOTH_ADVERTISE, BLUETOOTH_SCAN permissions and request runtime permissions. iOS/macOS: add NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription to Info.plist and enable Bluetooth capability on macOS. Windows: no extra setup beyond normal Bluetooth availability.
